description: This Swift source file defines a CLI (Command Line Interface) registry for the 'Swabble' project, setting up command descriptors for various subcommands such as serve, transcribe, mic management, service management, and system commands. It constructs a command hierarchy with associated descriptions and signatures.

classes.name: CLIRegistry
classes.description: An enum acting as a namespace for static methods and properties that define the command-line interface structure for the 'Swabble' application.

methods.name: descriptor(for:)
methods.description: A private static method that creates a CommandDescriptor for a given ParsableCommand type, extracting its command description and signature.
